partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester for a European entry motion. Tempo is a founder-led micro-boutique (well under 40 people) serving 200+ early-stage tech companies, already deeply embedded in the Drata/Vanta automation ecosystems and publicly claiming AWS-architecture fluency — exactly the profile that can validate LoxeAI and route pre-audit SaaS clients to it. Caveat: UK/Europe-based, so it complements rather than replaces a US-first referral channel; SOC 2 opinions run through US partner Sensiba, which could also make Tempo a warm intro path into a larger US CPA firm.
pitch_note: Rob — you built Tempo because legacy audit firms were too slow for early-stage tech; LoxeAI exists for the same reason on the readiness side. It's an AWS-native SOC 2 readiness scanner built for lean startups: would you take 30 minutes to run it against a sandbox AWS account and tear apart the findings as an auditor? If it holds up, your pre-audit pipeline gets a simple play — 'run this scan first, it gets you ~80% ready' — so clients arrive at your Type 1/Type 2 engagements cleaner and faster, at zero cost to Tempo.
